title: Charge-backs and Account Locks — Harborline Customer Accounts
content:
# Charge-backs and account locks

## Rule

When a card or PayPal deposit is charged back, its disputed amount plus the charge-back fee is debited from credit even if the balance goes below zero, and the account is locked where the tier's charge-back lock setting is on. Trust and Safety may also lock an account for a suspected compromise. A charge-back lock may be lifted only when the account's credit balance is zero or above or the payer's bank has withdrawn the dispute. A suspected-compromise lock is lifted only after the caller passes identity verification and the sign-in password has been reset. While locked, no purchase, deposit, withdrawal or goodwill can be made, but refunds may still be credited and existing products keep running.

The account record shows the lock reason, charge-back or suspected compromise, and an unlock returns the account to active once the cause is resolved and the caller is verified.

| Tier | Charge-back fee | A charge-back locks the account | Lock lifted only after repayment or a withdrawn dispute |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Personal Account | $25.00 | Yes (true) | Yes (true) |
| Harborline Business Account | $25.00 | Yes (true) | Yes (true) |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | $25.00 | Yes (true) | Yes (true) |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | $25.00 | Yes (true) | Yes (true) |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | $25.00 | Yes (true) | Yes (true) |
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | $25.00 | Yes (true) | Yes (true) |

## Worked case (hypothetical figures)

A $180.00 card deposit is charged back while the balance is $140.00. The debit is $180.00 plus the $25.00 fee, $205.00, leaving a balance of minus $65.00, and the account is locked with the reason charge-back. The lock may be lifted once the balance is $0.00 or above, or once the payer's bank has withdrawn the dispute.

## Lock-lifting conditions

| Lock reason | Condition for lifting |
|---|---|
| charge-back | credit balance zero or above, or the dispute withdrawn by the payer's bank |
| suspected compromise | identity verification passed and the sign-in password reset |

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts*
